title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: a vendor credit stays at the bottom when Due Date is sorted
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has two overdue bills, {Bill-A} and {Bill-B}, and one unused vendor credit, {Vendor-credit-A}, on today's date.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-23 Parts Co; {Bill-A} is due 10 days ago and {Bill-B} 20 days ago.
  • Starting screen: A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Expand {Vendor-A}'s group.
  2. Click the "Due Date" header.
  3. Click the "Due Date" header again.
  4. Click the "Past Due" header.
  5. Click the "Past Due" header again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the group shows the two bills and the vendor credit; {Vendor-credit-A}'s Due Date and Past Due cells hold no date or number (the screen draws a dash, "—"): a vendor credit has no due date and no Past Due here.
  • Step 2: {Bill-B}, then {Bill-A}, then {Vendor-credit-A} at the bottom of the group.
  • Step 3: {Bill-A}, then {Bill-B}, and {Vendor-credit-A} still at the bottom.
  • Step 4: {Bill-B} (20 days), then {Bill-A} (10 days), then {Vendor-credit-A} at the bottom.
  • Step 5: {Bill-A}, then {Bill-B}, and {Vendor-credit-A} still at the bottom.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R6: “A blank value (for example a vendor credit on A/P Unpaid Invoices, which has no due date and no Past Due) sorts to the bottom of its group in both directions. On A/P Detail a vendor credit shows its own date as its due date, as today, so it is not blank there.”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first. The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
